title: FY27-ENG-007 - Recreational Trails Grant Program 2022 Shiloh Bike Trails – Emergency Towers and Bike Repair Stations - Engineering Department

onscreen_lines.desc: Solar-Powered Emergency Phone Towers - Furnish all resources required to procure and install a solar-powered wireless blue light emergency phone tower in accordance with City Specifications/standard details and provided construction plans. Scope includes but is not limited to mobilization, site preparation, 24”x24”x24” concrete foundation, 24” J-bolts, installation, and site cleanup. All work Shall be bid as "Complete-in-Place" covering all incidentals necessary for a finished product.
